```{r}
#| label: 'debug-only-report-external'
#| eval: false
if (!exists("params")) params <- list(norm_method = "closest_norm", log_calibration = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: 'setup'
#| purl: true
# Load packages and project local libraries
options(box.path = Sys.getenv("R_BOX_PATH", "app/")) # Path to project local libraries
box::use(
  SumExp, # Light SummarizedExperiment, `[`
  projlib/msdial, # Handle MS-Dial files
  util = projlib/msdial_utils, # Utility functions for MS-Dial data
  projlib/show, # Functions to present data
  io = projlib/check_io_exist, # Check input/output files
  patchwork, # Combine ggplot objects. `+`
  ggplot2[...], # Too long to write and usually specific enough
  ggfortify, # PCA plot (autoplot)
)
# The ID of the matrix after blank subtraction.
MAT_ID_BLANK_SUBT <- util$mat_id_of_blank_subtracted(params$norm_method)
# The matrix ID of processed data used for calibration.
MAT_ID_IN_CALIB <- util$mat_id_in_calibration(MAT_ID_BLANK_SUBT)

# Get the input file name provided by the user
user_inputs <- msdial$get_user_input()
# To keep constants consistent across reports
# The app directory: `APP_ROOT` (absolute, set by the app / Docker), else `app/` from the project root
app_root <- Sys.getenv("APP_ROOT", "app")
constants_yml <- yaml::read_yaml(file.path(app_root, "constants.yml"))
COLORS <- lapply(constants_yml$COLORS, unlist) # Lists to named vectors
raw_se <- msdial$read_parsed_msdial_data(user_inputs)
# For consistency throughout the report
COLORS_OF_CLASSES <- show$get_colors_of_classes(raw_se, COLORS$.ctrl_cat)

if (SumExp::metadata(raw_se)$is_non_target_mode) {
  stop("This report is only for targeted analysis mode.")
}

# Input files
FILE <- list(
  i = rlang::list2(
    # Processed data
    proc = msdial$get_raw_data_file_name(user_inputs, suffix = "proc"),
    # Intermediate status of the data
    to_rep = msdial$get_raw_data_file_name(user_inputs, suffix = "to_report"),
  )
)
# Check if input files and output directories exist
io$check_io_exist(FILE)

# Load the intermediate data during QC
to_report <- readRDS(FILE$i$to_rep)
stopifnot("Processing NOT completed." = to_report[["Completed"]])

log_scale <- to_report[["params"]][["log_calibration"]]

# Load the processed data using the specified normalization method
lst_proc <- readRDS(FILE$i$proc)[[MAT_ID_BLANK_SUBT]] |>
  lapply(\(per_batch) {
    has_ex <- SumExp::row_df(per_batch$concn)$to_export
    lapply(per_batch[c("concn", "calcurve")], \(se) se[has_ex, ]) # Remove features without values
  })
concn_lst <- lapply(lst_proc, \(ea) {
  se <- ea$concn
  # Exclude control samples
  util$exclude_ctrl_smpl_cat(se, c("QC"))
})
calib_lst <- lapply(lst_proc, \(x) x$calcurve)

# Consistancy throughout this report ----------
# To keep the same format
summary_tbl <- lapply(concn_lst, msdial$tbl_chemical_summary) |>
  purrr::list_rbind(names_to = "Batch") |>
  dplyr::mutate( # Tidy up the table
    chem_name = stringr::str_trunc(chem_name, 40),
    perc_detf = round(100 * n_det / n_samples, 1),
    model_r2 = ifelse(is.na(model_r2), NA_character_, sprintf("%.3f", model_r2)),   # Always 3 decimals
    dplyr::across(   # At most 3 decimals, as in the exported tables
      c(median, mean, min, max, lod, lloq),
      ~ round(.x, 3)
    ),
    dplyr::across(
      c(median, mean, min, max, lod, lloq),
      ~ as.character(.x)
    )
  )
```

{{< pagebreak >}}

## Blank filtering

Features were filtered based on blank samples.
A feature was kept if its maximum peak area in the samples was $> `r to_report$blank_filter_factor` \times$ the average blank peak area, OR if its average peak area in samples was $> `r to_report$blank_filter_factor` \times$ the average blank peak area.

```{r}
# Features removed by the blank filter and the QC RSD% filter (for the method of this report)
removed <- to_report[["removed features"]]
removed <- if (is.null(removed)) NULL else removed[removed$mat_id == params$norm_method, ]
removed_n <- if (is.null(removed)) NA else sum(removed$reason == "Blank filter")
```

A total of `r removed_n` features were removed in this step.

```{r}
#| results: 'asis'
rf <- to_report[["qc rsd filter"]]
if (isTRUE(rf$enabled)) {
  cat("\n## QC RSD% filtering\n\n")
  limits <- c(
    if (!is.na(rf$max_targeted)) paste0("targeted features with a QC RSD% above ", rf$max_targeted, "%"),
    if (!is.na(rf$max_nontargeted)) paste0("non-targeted features with a QC RSD% above ", rf$max_nontargeted, "%")
  )
  cat("After normalization and blank subtraction,", paste(limits, collapse = " and "),
      "were removed (RSD% among the QC replicates).\n\n")
  if (isTRUE(rf$skipped)) {
    cat("**This filter was requested but skipped.**", rf$skip_reason, "\n\n")
  } else {
    rem_rsd <- removed[removed$reason == "QC RSD%", ]
    cat(paste0("A total of ", nrow(rem_rsd), " features were removed in this step (",
               sum(rem_rsd$targeted), " targeted and ", sum(!rem_rsd$targeted), " non-targeted).\n\n"))
  }
}
```

## PCA

```{r}
#| label: 'pca'
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4
plot_pca <- function(se, mat_id) {
  mat <- t(se[[mat_id]])
  # Scale is not possible with all zeros
  mat <- mat[, colSums(mat, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, drop = FALSE]
  # Remove constant rows
  mat <- mat[, apply(mat, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, drop = FALSE]
  # If there are no features, return an empty plot
  if (ncol(mat) <= 1) {
    return(ggplot() +
      ggtitle("No features for PCA"))
  }
  pca_res <- stats::prcomp(mat, scale. = TRUE)

  se_df <- SumExp::col_df(se) # `data` in ggplot2::autoplot
  # Plot
  ggplot2::autoplot(pca_res, data = se_df, colour = "Class")
}
both_se_lst <- lapply(to_report[["normalized - blank"]], \(se) {
  se <- util$exclude_ctrl_smpl_cat(se, c("QC", "CalCurve", "Blank"))
  se[!util$is_targeted_feature(se), ] # Only `Quant` targeted chemicals
})
for (batch_id in names(both_se_lst)) {
  cat("\n\n### Batch ", batch_id, "\n")
  both_se <- both_se_lst[[batch_id]]
  concn_se <- concn_lst[[batch_id]]
  p1 <- plot_pca(both_se, MAT_ID_BLANK_SUBT) + ggtitle("Target + Non-target")
  p2 <- plot_pca(concn_se, MAT_ID_IN_CALIB) + ggtitle("Target")
  print(p1 + p2 + patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect"))
}
```

  to_report$params$llox_method,
  "pt_signal_mean" = paste(

    "the mean signal of the blank (zero concentration point)."

**Note**

The unit of concentration is `r user_inputs$concentration_unit`.

```{r}

qmd <- "_external-llox_from_llox_signal.qmd"
cat(knitr::knit_child(file.path(app_root, "reports", "chapters", qmd), quiet = TRUE))
```

```{r}
#| label: 'calibration-curve-steps-txt'
lod_signal_txt <- switch(to_report$params$llox_method,
  "pt_signal_mean" = "3× the mean signal of the blank (zero concentration point)",
  "pt_signal_mean_plus_sd" = 
    "mean signal of the blank (zero concentration point) plus 3× its standard deviation"
)
```

After the computation of concentration, the following steps are applied to the data:

  * Any calibrated concentration between the LOD and LLOQ is adjusted to the 1/2 of LLOQ.
  * Any calibrated concentration below the LOD is adjusted to the 1/4 of LLOQ.
  * Any calibrated concentration below LLOQ while peak signal > the average signal of LLOQ is adjusted to LLOQ.
  * Any calibrated concentration whose signal is below the average signal of LLOQ is adjusted to the 1/2 of LLOQ.
  * Any calibrated concentration whose signal is below the LOD signal threshold (`r lod_signal_txt`) is adjusted to 1/4 of LLOQ.
  * Any chemical with values below LLOQ in all samples is removed from the quantification report.

# Invidual chemicals

```{r}
#| label: 'individual-chemicals'
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6
#' Text box to describe a calibration curve model
textbox_of_a_width <- function(txt, width) {
  ggplot() +
    ggtext::geom_textbox(
      aes(x = 0, y = 0.9, label = txt),
      box.color = "black",
      width = width,
      fill = NA,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 4
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_void()
}

for (batch_id in names(concn_lst)) {
  cat("\n\n## Batch ", batch_id, "\n")
  cat("\n\n{{< pagebreak >}}\n\n")
  concn_se <- concn_lst[[batch_id]]
  calib_se <- calib_lst[[batch_id]]

  c_concs <- util$spiked_conc_pts(calib_se)
  lowest_c <- min(c_concs[c_concs > 0])

  stopifnot(identical(rownames(concn_se), summary_tbl$chem_id[summary_tbl$Batch == batch_id]))

  for (i_chem in rownames(concn_se)) { # For each chemical
    x_se <- concn_se[i_chem, ]
    chem_name <- SumExp::row_df(x_se)$feature_name
    cat("\n\n### ", chem_name, "\n")

    # Calibration curves
    p1 <- show$ggplot_calcurve_samples(x_se,
      calib_se,
      mat_id = MAT_ID_IN_CALIB,
      COLORS_OF_CLASSES,
      log_scale = log_scale
    ) +
      labs(
        title = "Full range",
        y = "Peak area (Normalized)"
      )
    if (!log_scale) {
      p2 <- p1 +
        show$coord_zoom_in_by_cc(n_cc = 3, mat_id = MAT_ID_IN_CALIB) +
        labs(title = "Zoom-in (3 cal. pts.)")
    }
    # Distribution of the concentration by class; points of the values replaced by the LOD/LLOQ
    # rules coloured as in the exported tables
    x_df <- SumExp::as_tibble(x_se) |>
      dplyr::mutate(kind = show$imputed_kind(conc, lloq))
    p3 <- ggplot(x_df, aes(x = Class, y = conc)) +
      geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Class), color = "grey30", alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
      geom_jitter(aes(color = kind), width = 0.2, height = 0, size = 1.2) +
      labs(
        x = show$label_if_has(x_df$Class, "Class"),
        y = show$label_if_has(x_df$conc, "Concentration"),
        color = NULL
      ) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) + # Vertical x-axis
      theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
      guides(fill = "none", color = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
      scale_y_log10(labels = show$label_e) +   # Scientific notation, as the other plots
      scale_color_manual(values = show$imputed_colors, drop = TRUE) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = COLORS_OF_CLASSES)

    # Text in the box
    text1 <- local(
      envir = as.list(summary_tbl[summary_tbl$chem_id == i_chem & summary_tbl$Batch == batch_id, ]),
      {
        paste0(
          "Best model: ", best_model, "  \n",
          "R2: ", model_r2, "  \n",
          "N of points: ", n_conc, "  \n",
          "DF: ", perc_detf, " (", n_det, "/", n_samples, ")", "  \n",
          "LOD: ", lod, "  \n",
          "LLOQ: ", lloq, "  \n",
          "" # For trailing comma
        ) |>
          textbox_of_a_width(width = unit(7, "cm"))
      }
    )

    txt_legend <- paste0(
      "The gray areas in the calibration curve represent the regions below LOD and LLOQ.  \n",
      paste(df_desc, "  \n"),
      "LOD: Limit of detection.  \n", # "  \n" is for line break
      "LLOQ: Lower limit of quantification  \n",
      "The details of LOD and LLOQ are described in the text of the chemical summary table.  \n",
      "" # For trailing comma
    ) |>
      textbox_of_a_width(width = unit(16, "cm"))

    # Plot
    if (log_scale) {
      design <- "
        111222
        111222
        334444
      "
      print(p1 + p3 + text1 + txt_legend +
        patchwork::plot_layout(design = design, guides = "collect"))
    } else {
      design <- "
        112233
        112233
        445555
      "
      print(p1 + p2 + p3 + text1 + txt_legend +
        patchwork::plot_layout(design = design, guides = "collect"))
    }
  }
}
```
